Your plan

We build this together. Follow along and tap as we talk. At the end you get your own plan to keep.

Step 1

What's your goal?

Pick the one that fits best.

Step 2

Pick your way

There is no wrong choice. You can switch later.

Step 3

Build your week

Tap a day, then tap a meal to add foods. Use the gold button under a meal to repeat it all week.

Step 4

One next step

You picked a way and a goal. What is one small action you will take next?

Step 5

Your toolkit

Add what you want in your plan.

Last step

Your take-home plan

Tap to add or remove. Then save your PDF.
